aboutHtml:
Richard and Nicky Baker opened STIHL SHOP Feilding in 2010 and we remain locally owned and operated. We stock STIHL and other major outdoor power equipment brands, alongside cycles, e-bikes, and home heating products. Feilding locals rely on us for everything from lawn care to property maintenance.

Our team takes time to help each customer find the right equipment for their needs. We offer professional ongoing advice, handle servicing and repairs, and stock parts to keep your machines running well. We know our gear and we're here to make sure you get exactly what suits your work.

We're proud to be part of the Feilding community, sponsoring local sports and supporting our volunteer organisations. Come in and see Richard, Dan and the team. We'll help you find what you're after.
